sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sarvajeet Singh,Abhilasha Singh,Ashutosh Yadav,Dinesh Yadav,Raj
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dileep Chandra Mishra
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard Shri Dinesh Yadav and Shri Rajesh Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant,
learned AGA for the State, Shri Dileep Chandra Mishra, learned counsel appearing for the informant and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that daughter of the informant was married to one Teer Singh, the son of the applicant herein, and subsequently it was informed that on 13.04.2023, the daughter was killed.
It was alleged that the entire family members had killed the daughter of the informant.
3. Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is that the applicant is the father-in-law, there is no allegation of demanding any dowry specifically against the applicant.

He draws my attention to Rajveer Singh vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63879858/
1 the medical report on record which indicates cause of death as Asphyxia with strangulation.

entities.text: Rajveer Singh vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The medical report also indicates a ligature mark present below the thyroid region.
There is prima-facie no statement except for the statement of the informant with regard to commission of an offence under Section 304B IPC against the applicant.
The inquest report also does not report any injury on the body.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the applicant is father-in-law aged about 62 years and prima-facie,
material to implicate the applicant with the offence under Section 304B IPC is missing coupled with the fact that general allegations have been levelled against the entire family members, as such, the applicant who is in custody since 27.04.2023 is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rajveer Singh be released on bail in FIR No.0068 of 2023, under Section 498A,
304B IPC & Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Kaila Devi, District Sambhal on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 18.12.2023 nishant  Rajveer Singh vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63879858/
